lines.text: Hushai the Archite greets Absalom as king and promises to serve him as he served his father.
Ahithophel advises Absalom to sleep with his father's concubines, and Absalom does so on a tent on the roof.
Ahithophel proposes choosing twelve thousand men to pursue David that night, and Absalom and the elders of Israel approve.
Hushai urges gathering all Israel from Dan to Gilgal with Joab leading them, and Absalom prefers his advice.

wrong_details.true: Absalom himself leads them into battle

lines.text: Jonathan and Ahimaaz hide in a well at Bahurim, then warn David, who crosses the Jordan by noon.

wrong_details.true: David and all the people cross the Jordan by daybreak
